name: resource-hero
description: Resource Hero plugins for Claude (claude.ai, Claude Desktop and Claude Code): log, review and chart your own time, run timers and request time off in Resource Hero.

plugins.name: rh-connect
plugins.description: Admin setup and the Claude Code connection for your org's Resource Hero User MCP server (the Resource Hero MCP extension's tools only). Installed with rh-user.

plugins.name: rh-user
plugins.description: Log, correct and review your own time in Resource Hero, the Salesforce-native resource management app, run timers, check your forecast and capacity, request time off, and build a live dashboard of your week, through your org's Resource Hero MCP server.
